what: Verified a physical Quest 2 moving the stock Ada MetaHuman through the local Mac XR editor and Live Link Hub.
why: Confirms the live head and both wrists reach the rendered character, independently of the remote-computer setup.
details: The monitored interval contained 256 station pose frames and 94 valid wrist frames per side. Source head rotation changed by 87 degrees and left/right wrist positions moved 26/24 cm. Mesh samples showed head rotation and both wrists moving. Unreal evaluated the same session on Human_Quest_C. The observed OXRSys video transport was Wi-Fi with the headset recognized over USB. Individual finger joints were unavailable in this run.
